```{r}
#| include: false
root <- here::here()
if (!exists("CdaTable", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CdaTable <- data.table(Class = c("Low", "Significant", "High", "Very High", "Extreme"), `Population at risk` = CONTENT$columns[["Population at risk"]],
      `Loss of life` = CONTENT$columns[["Loss of life"]], `Construction, Operation and Transition` = CONTENT$columns[["Construction, Operation and Transition"]],
      `Closure and Passive Care` = CONTENT$columns[["Closure and Passive Care"]])
  setnames(CdaTable, CONTENT$headers)
  CdaNotes <- CONTENT$notes
}
```

```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-cda
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "tbl", "cda.R"))
TBL
```
